incomplete_candidate.reason: Official CPU library selected slow scalar ternary kernel. First audio remained unfinished beyond real-time duration; interrupted as unsuitable for daily use in this runtime.
incomplete_candidate.memory_scope: Windows peak working set before interruption
incomplete_candidate.time_scope: First-result wall latency from process start, including setup, weight identity checks, model load and WAV read; audio still incomplete.

download_accounting.note: Conservative new-download bound: dataset directory includes extracted local copies and synthetic controls. Preexisting Parakeet Q8 and Whisper base are reused and excluded. Installed/uncompressed environments occupy additional disk space.

english_secondary_normalization.operation: Apply only the British/American spelling dictionary to already normalized word tokens. Preserve parenthetical speech, numbers, contractions and fillers. Raw WER remains the primary metric.

public_it_paired_bootstrap.interpretation: Exploratory paired percentile bootstrap on this selected public subset; does not establish a universal model ranking or a personal-meeting confidence interval.
